claims.seen: White sink basin and framed mirror look clean and clear
One white clean hand towel hanging on chrome ring
Beige soap dispenser with black pump on sink
Sink counter clear except soap, no personal items visible

request.instructions:
You check whether a cleaned place was cleaned properly. Look only at the photos below.

Room: Powder room (white sink top with chrome faucet, grey framed mirror, towel ring, toilet with a bidet seat)

Checklist:
- powder-room.sink: Sink and mirror clean - Sink and mirror are clean
- powder-room.hand_towel: Hand towels hanging - 1 clean hand towel hanging, one at each sink (a reflection in the mirror does not count) (need at least 1)
- powder-room.hand_soap: Hand soap at the sink - A hand soap dispenser at the sink (need at least 1)
- powder-room.no_guest_items: No guest items left - No guest items left on the sink or the floor

Rules:
- For each item give status "done" only when one single photo clearly shows it done; "problem" only when one photo clearly shows it NOT done (dirty, missing, broken or left behind).
- Otherwise use "not_shown": the item is not in any photo, or the photo is too dark, blurry or far away to tell.
- Some photos may show other rooms: use only photos that show this room (compare what each photo shows with the room name and description above); never cite a photo of another room as proof for this room.
- Never guess. Judge only what is actually visible.
- photo_id is the one photo that shows the item best; leave it empty ("") when the status is "not_shown".
- seen: what is actually visible in that photo, in English, at most 25 words.
- count_seen: for items that need a minimum number, how many are visible in that one photo; count only what is visible in the cited photo; otherwise null.
- other_issues: damage or problems NOT on the checklist that a photo clearly shows (stain, broken lamp, missing mirror). Leave it empty when there are none.
- Return one claim for every checklist item above.
